category: text-to-speech and speech-to-text API, monthly free credit pool

free_tier.stated: Free plan at USD 0 with 10,000 credits per month, no credit card required. One shared monthly pool across every product: Text to Speech 1 credit per character on multilingual models (0.5 to 1 credit per character on Flash and Turbo through the API), Speech to Text 330 credits per minute, Eleven Music 900 credits per minute, Sound Effects 200 credits per generation. Free-plan API access is included; the pool resets each billing cycle and does not roll over.
free_tier.notes: models on the API pricing page: text-to-speech Eleven v4, v4 Turbo, v3 and Flash/Turbo families, speech-to-text Scribe v2 and Scribe v2 Realtime, music, sound effects, voice changer and voice isolator. unverified: which of these models the Free plan can call through the API, because the pages read list the Free column only as a credit count

interface_detail: HTTP and WebSocket requests from any language; official Python and Node.js libraries
tooling: official Python (pip install elevenlabs) and Node.js (@elevenlabs/elevenlabs-js) libraries, or raw HTTP and WebSocket with an API key created in the account settings
chaining: 10,000 credits a month is about 10,000 characters of text-to-speech, enough for short voice-over or a TTS smoke test inside a free CI job; the speech-to-text rate of 330 credits per minute makes this pool poor value for transcription, so send transcription to a service with a larger allowance and keep this pool for the voice.

limits.value: 10,000 credits per month on the Free plan, shared by every product, with no rollover on the Free plan
Free plan concurrency: text-to-speech 4 concurrent requests on Flash and Turbo models and 2 on all other models; speech-to-text 8 and realtime speech-to-text 6
the Voice Library is not available through the API to free-tier users

binding_note: the 10,000 credits per month pool is shared by every product and does not roll over on the Free plan, so it runs out before the 2-request concurrency cap matters

identity_cost.detail: no credit card ('No credit card required, no commitment'); the signup page offers Sign up with Google or an email with a password; unverified: whether a phone number or an email confirmation step follows the form

reliability_note: unused Free-plan credits are lost at the end of each billing cycle
confidence_note: the 10,000 credit pool, the per-product credit costs, the no-rollover rule, the concurrency tables and the card-free signup are quoted from vendor pages; the model set open to the Free plan through the API is unverified.
